notes: World-class audit, Medium batch 2 — the DbHelper pass (v12.10, DB v12, additive migration): M2 restore can no longer create case-variant duplicate suppliers (Ali vs ali) that double-counted To Pay — restore now merges suppliers case-insensitively (live phone + name casing kept), and the upgrade collapses any existing duplicates. M3 invoice numbers are never reused: the next number now comes from the AUTOINCREMENT high-water mark, so deleting the highest invoice (INV-005) and making a new one gives INV-006, not INV-005 again; invoice numbers are also UNIQUE in the database (existing duplicates renumbered on upgrade). M4 the database no longer trusts caller-supplied amounts — createInvoice validates every line (name, qty > 0, rate >= 0, finite) and recomputes the total as qty x rate, and the udhar / supplier / cash add + update methods reject non-finite amounts. M5 deleting a customer / supplier / invoice is now one atomic transaction (tombstones + deletes commit or roll back together — no orphan rows if the phone dies mid-delete). M6 renaming a customer or supplier now keeps the contact itself (phone, due date, credit limit) instead of deleting it and hoping the caller saves again.
